Title: Azure Stream Analytics integration with Power BI is now generally available

Body.Content:
Itegration between Azure Stream Analytics and Power BI is now generally availabile.

This integration enables you to output data directly from your streaming jobs to a real-time dashboards built in Power BI.
Real-time dashboards are a core scenario in streaming as they allow you to gain low latency insights in to your data in-motion which would otherwise be impossible.
With this integration between Stream Analytics and Power BI, building such dashboards is simple and intuitive.

For more information on this release, please see the following blog announcement - https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/streamanalytics-and-powerbi/
